title: The Hard Debt
author: Rafael Dunmore
blurb: Lena Vane, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, has spent twenty years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must burn the network that did the training before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
